name: v2.2.0-dev.3
body:
New development release, with some new features!

## New Features
* Add autosave feature by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/229
* Use `atom:updated` feed if available to infer date by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/245

## Interesting Backend Changes
* Bump electron from 41.10.7 to 44.7.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/235
* Update flake by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/242

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/compare/v2.2.0-dev.2...v2.2.0-dev.3

name: v2.2.0-dev.2
body:
## UI Changes
* Increase readability of read items by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/203
* Update CSS to prevent crushing sidebar by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/222

## Backend Changes
* Fix vulns and fix webpack.config.js by @nubesurrealista in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/182
* Fix new vulnerabilities by @nubesurrealista in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/185
* Remove redux-thunk, add reduxjs/toolkit by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/205
* Update package-lock, flake by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/188
* Switch nix build to use importNpmLock by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/189
* Replace SourcesContainer.tsx with Redux React SourcesTab function by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/198

## Misc
* Added RELEASES.md by @CrystalSplitter in https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/pull/223

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/compare/v2.2.0-dev.1...2.2.0-dev.2

name: v2.2.0-dev.1
body:
# Bug Fixes

- Fixes a bug where the "Load More" button would sometimes produce duplicate articles (Issue #179).
- Added node 24 support (Issue #176).

name: v2.2.0-dev.0
body:
Development release for v2.2.0-dev.0! This release introduces multiple bug fixes and improvements:

- Can now open feeds using a "default" mechanism (e.g. click a link, and it will by default open in browser)
- Minor vulnerability fixes in dependencies
- Better error handling in thumbnail decoding
- Reworking thumbnails to have lazy thumbnail loading for parallel thumbnail opengraph fetching + rate limiting. This should significantly improve thumbnail fetching performance!

As always, [please report any bugs](https://github.com/FluentFlame/fluentflame-reader/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)!

name: v2.1.0-dev.1
body:
This is a development release used for testing new versions of Fluentflame reader. It corresponds with `v2.1.0` currently.

v2.1.0 hopes to fix some long standing bugs such as:

* Unable to use services
* Better thumbnail parsing
* Minor vulnerabilities in dependencies
